from pathlib import Path
import time,json,subprocess,datetime
r=Path('/home/mscong1/mikros-experiments/20260912T-native64/v3')
while True:
 s=json.loads((r/'candidate/status.json').read_text())
 if s['stage']=='complete': break
 if s['stage']=='failed': raise RuntimeError('candidate failed; pooled candidate cancelled')
 time.sleep(5)
argv=['python3',str(r/'source/mikros/server_experiments/run_server_64.py'),'--root',str(r),'--skip-build','--results-name','pooled-candidate','--systems','reuse,factoredreuse,flock','--logs','30','--runs','6']
(r/'pooled-candidate-launch.json').write_text(json.dumps({'argv':argv,'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()},indent=2))
subprocess.run(argv,check=True)
